declined.subject: agent-cli-transport
declined.reason: None of the seam's own files spawn an agent CLI. A search of app/_server and the five app/api route directories for child_process, claudeCli and spawn( found nothing. lib/apiAuth.ts:4 only names a route ('app/api/frames spends local Claude-CLI compute') that the gate protects. But the context's lib/ files (principal, apiAuth, sessionToken, devAuth, firebase, useAuth) share the lib/ directory with the real spawners, lib/claudeCli.ts and lib/agent/*. A directory-scoped absence search would therefore hit, and not-applicable cannot be proven in the form the driver checks. I am not guessing a different state instead.
